title: Unit tests for parsePlan (src/apps/ide/agent-loop.ts)
instructions:
Add a new vitest unit test file `tests/ide/parse-plan.test.ts` for `parsePlan` in `src/apps/ide/agent-loop.ts`.
- Read the code first (it is pasted below) and assert what it actually does; if you think the code has a bug, say so in your final answer instead of changing it.
- Use `import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";` and import the code under test with a relative path ending in `.js` (for example `../../src/apps/ide/agent-loop.js`), like the other tests in this repository.
- Cover: a JSON list of steps keeps index, description and status; a missing index uses the position; a missing status becomes "pending"; a missing description becomes ""; a JSON object that is not a list and malformed JSON give null.
